## Technical Files (Root Directory)

### sitemap.xml
- **Location:** `/sitemap.xml`
- **Type:** XML file
- **Purpose:** Tells Google where all your pages are
- **Size:** 922 bytes
- **Content:** 5 URL entries with priority and frequency
- **Created by:** OpenCode
- **Status:** ✅ Live at https://sensoryark.com/sitemap.xml

**Structure:**
```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">
  <url>
    <loc>https://sensoryark.com/</loc>
    <lastmod>2025-08-16</lastmod>
    <changefreq>weekly</changefreq>
    <priority>1.0</priority>
  </url>
  <!-- 4 more URLs... -->
</urlset>
```

## Naming Convention

All files follow this pattern:
```
NN-DESCRIPTIVE-NAME.md
```

Where:
- `NN` = Two-digit number (00-99)
- `-` = Separator
- `DESCRIPTIVE-NAME` = What the file covers
- `.md` = Markdown format

This allows:
✅ Easy sorting by sequence
✅ Clear file names
✅ Scalable numbering (can go up to 99)
